\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=420pt,paperheight=560pt,textwidth=310pt,textheight=150pt,top=42pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}\raggedbottom
\makeatletter
\newcount\ODformatted
\newcount\ODoversize
\newcount\ODskips
\newdimen\ODcharge
\newwrite\ODnodes
\newwrite\ODpieces
\immediate\openout\ODnodes=\jobname.nodes
\immediate\openout\ODpieces=\jobname.pieces
\let\ODformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
 \global\advance\ODformatted by1
 \protected@write\ODnodes{}{ENTRY #1}%
 \ODformat{#1}}
\let\ODmeasure\dte@measurepiece
\def\dte@measurepiece#1{%
 \ODmeasure{#1}%
 \ODcharge=\dimexpr\ht\dte@tbox+\dp\dte@tbox-\maxdepth\relax
 \ifdim\ODcharge<\ht\dte@tbox\ODcharge=\ht\dte@tbox\fi
 \ifdim\ODcharge>\textheight
  \global\advance\ODoversize by1
  \typeout{OD-OVERSIZE type=#1;ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum;charge=\the\ODcharge;body=\the\textheight}%
 \fi}
\let\ODdraw\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
 \protected@write\ODpieces{}{PIECE \the\numexpr\dte@piecenum+1\relax:#1}%
 \ODdraw{#1}}
\let\ODskip\dte@skipcolumn
\def\dte@skipcolumn{\global\advance\ODskips by1\ODskip}
\AtEndDocument{%
 \ifnum\ODformatted=3\relax\else\errmessage{Lost or rebuilt semantic rows}\fi
 \ifnum\ODoversize>0\relax\else\errmessage{Oversized measured path not reached}\fi
 \ifnum\ODskips>1\relax\errmessage{Unexpected repeated deferral}\fi
 \typeout{OD-DONE rows=\the\ODformatted;oversized=\the\ODoversize;skips=\the\ODskips;pieces=\the\dte@piecenum}}

\newcount\ODminimum
\newcount\ODlastrejects
\newcount\ODclosingminimum
\newcount\ODterminal
\let\ODtrackedmeasure\dte@measurepiece
\def\dte@measurepiece#1{%
 \ODtrackedmeasure{#1}%
 \ifnum\dte@pagecount=0\relax
  \ifx\dte@piecetype\dte@pfirst
   \ifdim\dte@availht=\dte@minht\relax
    \ifdim\ODcharge>\textheight
     \global\advance\ODminimum by1
     \typeout{OD-MINIMUM target=\the\dte@availht;minimum=\dte@minht;charge=\the\ODcharge}%
    \fi
   \fi
  \fi
 \fi}
\let\ODdiscard\dte@discardpiece
\def\dte@discardpiece{%
 \ifnum\dte@pagecount>0\relax
  \ifx\dte@piecetype\dte@plast\global\advance\ODlastrejects by1\relax\fi
 \fi
 \ODdiscard}
\let\ODminht\dte@compute@minht
\def\dte@compute@minht{%
 \ODminht
 \ifnum\dte@pagecount>0\relax
  \ifdim\dte@minht<\dimexpr\ht\dte@framebox+\dp\dte@framebox\relax\else
   \global\advance\ODclosingminimum by1
   \typeout{OD-CLOSING-MINIMUM min=\dte@minht;total=\the\dimexpr\ht\dte@framebox+\dp\dte@framebox\relax}%
  \fi
 \fi}
\let\ODcont\dte@dosplit@cont
\def\dte@dosplit@cont{%
 \ODcont
 \ifnum\dte@defercount=0\relax\else\errmessage{Output did not reset deferral}\fi
 \ifnum\ODclosingminimum>0\relax
  \ifx\dte@piecetype\dte@plast\else\errmessage{No terminal last output}\fi
  \ifvoid\dte@framebox\errmessage{Terminal-copy source was cleared}\fi
  \ifvoid\dte@tbox\else\errmessage{Measured output not consumed}\fi
  \global\advance\ODterminal by1
 \fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
 \ifnum\ODlastrejects>0\relax\else\errmessage{No closing rejection}\fi\ifnum\ODclosingminimum>0\relax\else\errmessage{No impossible smaller closing piece}\fi\ifnum\ODterminal>0\relax\else\errmessage{No terminal-copy acceptance}\fi
 \typeout{OD-PATH minimum=\the\ODminimum;lastrejects=\the\ODlastrejects;closingminimum=\the\ODclosingminimum;terminal=\the\ODterminal}}

\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{dirtreex}[box={margin={6pt,6pt,200pt,6pt}}]
\dir{ROOT}{C001}{\file{A}{C002}\file{B}{C003}}
\end{dirtreex}
\end{document}
